subject: Altagrid security intake - CAIQ / SIG pre-call and artifact handoff
messages:
From: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@altagrid.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ / SIG intake - request to schedule pre-call

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking Altagrid on as a potential vendor. We're starting our SIG/CAIQ intake and would like to run a short pre-call to confirm scope and artifact handoff. Our primary goals are:
- Understand Redwood's deployment modes and data residency options for our EU customers
- Confirm logging/retention evidence you can provide (access logs, audit trails)
- Walk through a CAIQ spreadsheet and expected attachments for the SIG intake

Available windows next week (PST): Tue 10-11am, Wed 2-4pm, Thu 9-11am. Could you propose 30–45 minute slots? I'll loop in our security engineer.

I've attached the initial CAIQ export we ran to help you triage gaps (Altagrid_CAIX_export_20270520.pdf).

Cheers,
Sarah Bennett
Head of Security Programs | Altagrid
(sarah.bennett@altagrid.com)

Attachment: Altagrid_CAIX_export_20270520.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@altagrid.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ / SIG intake - request to schedule pre-call

Hi Sarah — great to meet you over email. Thanks for sending the CAIQ export.

We can definitely run a focused intake to triage gaps and map owners. Proposed 30-minute slot: Tue 2027-05-25 10:30–11:00am PST. Ben (account exec) and Kimberly (security & compliance) are cc'd and will join.

High-level agenda we suggest:
1) 5m introductions + scope (which customers/regions you care about)
2) 10m CAIQ gap triage and required artifacts list
3) 10m evidence logistics (S3/Drive, retention, sampling) + next steps
4) 5m action owners + timeline

Kimberly — any pre-call asks you want the Altagrid team to upload before the meeting?

If that slot works, I'll send a calendar invite and include a short prep doc.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior CSM, Customer Compliance | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-sig-intake-template.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@altagrid.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ / SIG intake - request to schedule pre-call

Hi Sarah — thanks for sending the export. A couple of quick pre-call asks so we can be efficient: 

1) Please upload a CAIQ spreadsheet (CSV or XLSX) if available — the PDF is helpful but structured CAIQ makes triage faster.
2) Provide a sample of access/logging evidence (one day compressed sample is fine) and network flow sampling if you have it. Tarball or S3 link OK.
3) Confirm whether you need coverage for EU-resident data in our Hosted product or if Dedicated/Private is required.

On the call we'll cover: CAIQ mapping, evidence types (audit logs, config snapshots, KMS/HSM logs), retention windows, and a proposed artifact cadence for the SIG questionnaire.

I'll bring the CAIQ mapping template (attached) and an example evidence manifest so we can assign owners live.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Manager, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-sig-intake-template.xlsx (XLSX, 36KB)

From: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@altagrid.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Jamal Ortiz <jamal.ortiz@altagrid.com>, Altagrid Security Team <security@altagrid.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ / SIG intake - request to schedule pre-call

Thanks Marissa — Tue 10:30 works for us. I've added Jamal (security engineer) in cc.

Pre-call attachments: I've uploaded the CAIQ spreadsheet and a one-day log sample to our S3 intake bucket at s3://altagrid-evidence/redwood/intake/20270522/. Files: network-flow-sample-20270520.tar.gz and CAIQ_export_20270520.xlsx. If you prefer Google Drive, let me know and we'll mirror.

We also flagged three control areas that historically cause questions: key management (KMS separation), multi-tenant isolation for hosted plans, and log export cadence. We'll want to confirm what evidence artifacts Redwood can provide by default vs. what requires Dedicated/Private.

See you Tue — Jamal will share any additional artifacts before the call.

Best,
Sarah

Attachments: network-flow-sample-20270520.tar.gz (TAR.GZ, 18MB), CAIQ_export_20270520.xlsx (XLSX, 200KB)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@altagrid.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ / SIG intake - request to schedule pre-call - meeting notes and next steps

Hi Sarah, Jamal — thanks again for the pre-call today. Quick notes and actions below.

Meeting summary (30m):
- Attendees: Sarah Bennett (Altagrid), Jamal Ortiz (Altagrid), Marissa Cole (Redwood), Kimberly Park (Redwood), Ben Carter (Redwood)
- Scope: CAIQ / SIG intake for Altagrid's use of Redwood Hosted across US and EU customers; evaluating Dedicated for stronger separation guarantees
- Key control focus areas called out by Altagrid: KMS key separation, tenant isolation, and log export cadence

Decisions and clarifications:
- Redwood provided default evidence set for Hosted (config snapshots, platform audit logs, redwood-managed KMS audit entries). Dedicated adds tenant-dedicated hosts and additional key controls.
- We agreed to map the CAIQ answers to explicit artifacts and owners; Redwood will fill as many items as possible and mark items requiring customer-supplied evidence.

Action items (owners & target dates):
1) Redwood: Fill CAIQ mapping for sections A1-A6 and return with evidence checklist — owner: Kimberly Park — due 2027-05-28
2) Altagrid: Provide sampling of KMS audit logs for review — owner: Jamal Ortiz — due 2027-05-27 (upload to s3://altagrid-evidence/redwood/intake/20270522/)
3) Redwood: Share sample platform audit logs (anonymized) and manifest template — owner: Marissa Cole — due 2027-05-26
4) Marissa/Ben: Prep follow-up intake session (45m) to review filled CAIQ and outstanding asks — schedule target: week of 2027-06-01

Artifacts confirmed received: CAIQ_export_20270520.xlsx, network-flow-sample-20270520.tar.gz (S3). We have the CAIQ template Redwood provided attached.

Next steps: Kimberly will post the CAIQ mapping to the HubSpot deal (HS-2451) and link the artifact checklist. Marissa will send a calendar invite for the follow-up.

If anything is missing from these notes, reply-all and we will amend.

Thanks — looking forward to the next session.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior CSM, Customer Compliance | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-sig-intake-template.xlsx (XLSX, 36KB); Meeting recording link: https://meet.redwood.ai/rec/20270523/altagrid-intake (recording pending processing)
